name: Minecraft: Fabric
description: Modded Minecraft with the Fabric loader. Drop your mods into the mods/ folder from the file manager.

install.label: Install the Fabric server launcher
install.run:
LOADER="{{LOADER_VERSION}}"
if [ "$LOADER" = "latest" ] || [ -z "$LOADER" ]; then
  LOADER=$(curl -sf https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader | node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);console.log((j.find(x=>x.stable)||j[0]).version);})')
fi
INSTALLER=$(curl -sf https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/installer | node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);console.log((j.find(x=>x.stable)||j[0]).version);})')
gp_log "Fabric loader $LOADER / installer $INSTALLER for Minecraft {{MC_VERSION}}"
gp_fetch "https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader/{{MC_VERSION}}/$LOADER/$INSTALLER/server/jar" server.jar
mkdir -p mods

install.content:
# Accepted through GamePanel on install
eula=true
